column2: Fluctuation from the discrete nature of the current flowing into the base. Its size is 2q·Ib. With a large resistance on the base side, this current noise turns into a noticeable voltage.

column2: Thermal noise of the transistor's internal base resistance rb (4kT·rb). It matters in low-noise amplifiers with a low source resistance.

column1: rb の小さい品種を選びます。信号源抵抗が大きい回路では、ほとんど影響しません。

column1: 抵抗の熱雑音 (ジョンソン雑音)

column1: 抵抗の中の電子は熱で絶えず動き回り、電圧が揺らぎます。電流が流れていなくても出ます。電圧の密度は √(4kT·R) で、周波数によらず一定 (白色雑音)。
column2: Electrons inside a resistor keep moving because of heat, so the voltage fluctuates. It appears even with no current. The voltage density is √(4kT·R) and is the same at all frequencies (white noise).

column1: 抵抗値を小さくすると減ります (4倍の抵抗値で雑音は2倍)。温度を下げても減ります。
column2: It goes down with a smaller resistance (4x the resistance gives 2x the noise). Lowering the temperature also helps.

column1: ダイオードのショット雑音

column1: 順方向電流を小さくすると減ります。
column2: It goes down with a smaller forward current.

column1: スイッチの抵抗の熱雑音

column2: Thermal noise of the on-resistance (a large resistance when off). A conducting switch makes 4kT·R noise just like a resistor.

column1: オン抵抗を小さくすると減ります。
column2: It goes down with a smaller on-resistance.

column1: MOSFET チャネルの熱雑音
